title: Restart the local strong theory conditional on a finite Fisher bound
statement: Assume S_T=sup_(t<T) I_m finite on a finite local strong interval. Sobolev gives ||f_i||3<=C_S m_i S_T/4, and Coulomb splitting gives potential infinity<=C_P sqrt(n_i m_i S_T), C_P=(8pi/3)^(1/3)sqrt(C_S). For M_q=sum m_i int f_i<v>^q, convex symmetrization makes drift nonpositive and M_q(t)<=M_q(0)exp(K_q sqrt(S_T)t), K_q=2q(q-1)C_P max_i[m_i^-2 sum_j c_ij sqrt(n_j m_j)]. Convex radial truncations continued linearly justify propagation before moments are assumed. The local continuation norm Y7=sum int f_i^2<v>7 is <=(C_S/4)^(3/2)(m1+m2)S_T^(3/2)sqrt(M14(0))exp(K14 sqrt(S_T)t/2). Applying the actual weighted-L2 local lemma retains n_i: f_i=n_i g_i gives c_ij n_j and weighted symmetry n_i c_ij n_j=n_j c_ji n_i. Thus finite maximal strong lifetime implies unbounded Fisher supremum. No bound on S_T in terms of initial data is obtained.
